verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows OpenAI acknowledges relying on third-party-published evals for competitor comparisons and users reference an external 'Terminal Bench' score, indicating some independent evaluation presence, but there's no systematic evidence of GPT models appearing on established third-party leaderboards (e.g., LMSYS Arena, HELM) or vendor-independent benchmark suites. missing for 10: citations to recognized independent leaderboards/arenas, comprehensive third-party benchmark tracking, and confirmation these are regularly updated/vendor-independent rather than ad hoc HN mentions.
